Photo 1 shows one of the rims mounted with a tyre, lying on its side on a concrete surface. The tyre has visible tread but appears worn and dusty. A hand is touching the tyre stack, suggesting it is part of a set.
The watermark 'EASTSON GLOBAL WHEELS' is present on both photos, indicating a possible seller or distributor brand, but not necessarily the rim or tyre brand.
The rims appear to be of the same design and size, suggesting a matching set.
